carla_camera_pose — DRIVE carla op

• Data kinds: any → matrix

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.carla_camera_pose(cam_transform6) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import carlabridge; carlabridge.carla_camera_pose(cam_transform6) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("carla_camera_pose"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

CARLA のカメラの世界姿勢 → render3d / driveworld の world → camera 4×4(:func:driveworld.camera_pose と同じ型)。

CARLA のカメラは局所 +x を見て右 = +y・上 = +z、render3d は −z を見て右 = +x・上 = +y。
